prompt: Create one square 1024x1024 head-and-shoulders dialogue portrait for Warwrit. Serious grounded low fantasy in the project's selected restrained graphic-novel direction. Confident irregular dark ink contours around major forms, broad matte flat colour washes, coherent shadow masses and calm secondary surfaces. Selective interior strokes, readable warm skin, desaturated slate/soot/umber with restrained ochre. Opaque quiet charcoal-grey backdrop, soft overcast light from upper left. Entire head and crown within the canvas, generous top and side margins. Distinct realistic human face, legible at 120px. Practical worn linen, wool, leather and plain iron as appropriate to the subject. One single portrait, no text, lettering, heraldry, watermark, frame, scenery, collage or other people. Avoid glamour, photorealistic skin microtexture, smooth CGI and cartoon exaggeration. Facial features and noncanonical ages below are production interpretations, not new story facts. Senka, the sixteen-year-old farm worker rescued from the old mill. Fully clothed nonsexual head-and-shoulders portrait of an ordinary teenage boy with a narrow youthful face, untidy chestnut hair, light freckles and a small smudge of old grain dust at one cheek. Plain faded brown linen shirt and worn grey wool vest. Apprehensive but attentive eyes, closed mouth, looking slightly left. No beard, weapons, injuries or heroic pose.
adaptation: Adapted the selected reference contour hierarchy, muted flat washes and practical costume materials to a distinct dialogue portrait. Facial features and unstated ages are production interpretations. Senka remains sixteen as authored.
